task: Bounded descriptive actual-return latitude analysis, Nov10
analysis_unit: Every frozen qualifying actual-return event; repeated events within a SID retained
event_definition: Exactly inherited all_return_events event IDs and UTC; no new return classification
departure_reference: The observed departure opening the matched A risk episode that ends at this qualifying return; retain and compare any canonical event-source departure field before finalizing the ledger
latitude_definition: Signed track latitude at the observed departure UTC and actual return UTC; no interpolation and no event-latitude truncation at plus/minus40 degrees
bin_rule: Left-closed, right-open 10 degree bins; last bin includes +90. Keep every prespecified bin, including zero-count bins.
hemisphere: NH for latitude >0, SH for latitude <0, EQ for exactly0; preserve departure and return hemisphere separately
displacements: absolute return latitude minus absolute departure latitude in degrees; positive denotes poleward magnitude increase
summaries: Event counts and distinct SID counts by signed bin, hemisphere and basin; preserve event and SID counts as distinct quantities; counts only, no p-values, models, confidence intervals or causal attribution
denominator_reuse: Reuse R1 A true observable risk-hours and R1 B annual global uniqueSID/genesis-year numerators/denominators without fitting a new global model
global_trend_source: R1/agents/B/annual_trends_and_basin_interactions.csv; exact stored 0.5284431632845179 [-0.49922822434316405,1.5561145509121999] percentage points per decade
scope_boundary: No 48h risk model, no redefinition of eligibility, no latitude-conditioned occurrence denominator or causal claim from this event-only distribution, no figures or DOCX
input_policy: R1 and original sources read-only; stream track columns and retain only required event rows; all output/cache/temp in this R2 agent directory
